headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback to edge out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs. In another Pirates win, Yohan Ramírez earned the win and Mason Montgomery secured the save in a 3-2 victory over the Brewers.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. William Kempner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow sprain with the Miami Marlins. The Milwaukee Brewers have also been affected, with Brandon Woodruff transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation, and Kyle Harrison placed on the 15-day injured list with left forearm tightness.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place around the league. Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 3-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Yohan Ramírez earning the win and Mason Montgomery securing the save.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, marking their loss in the matchup. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Athletics dropped a 1-0 decision to the Chicago White Sox, marking their final score. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a key double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Marlins' Kempner Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher William Kempner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow sprain.

top_news.title: **Shewmake Joins Brewers in Trade**
top_news.summary: Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers. The shortstop was previously acquired by the Brewers in a trade with the Houston Astros.
